algorithm: Original WavePDE convected wave solve + characteristic tracing

provenance.grid_policy: per-source 4 m crop; width rounded to 128 cells with 68 m endpoint margins

wind.terrain_adapter: Original flat-geometry wind sampled at local AGL; not recomputed on restored terrain

limitations: Browser geometry uses a rendering-only simplification with maximum 0.25 m deviation. All displayed segments are independently collision-checked again; full-resolution original WavePDE paths remain in the retained run.
Original WavePDE solve and plain characteristic tracing; no A* paths or graph-search fallback. Only successful, collision-checked routes are displayed; failed attempts remain in the retained run.
Each source uses an adaptive local crop (4608–7680 m wide) with 4 x 4 x 4 m voxels. This is not a full-domain global-optimality or all-9900-pairs result.
PDE first-peak arrival time is retained separately. Playback time integrates the recorded path using the solver airspeed ellipsoid and frozen wind; it is not a measured flight time.

Native 8 m frozen 3-D model wind at 7500 s, interpolated onto the 4 m planning grid, is transferred by local height above terrain from the original flat geometry; it was not recomputed or validated by CFD on the restored terrain.
100 irregular synthetic ground stations (minimum separation 450 m), with 12 m takeoff and landing gates. Flight ceiling 25 m AGL; no real landing-site survey or vehicle-dynamics validation.

Collision checks use conservative 4 m horizontal / 3 m vertical planning padding and 0.5 m path sampling against 2 m terrain/building/tree columns. Columns cannot represent underpasses, wires or moving obstacles.
Building examples mean the straight reference at the same gates intersects building columns. A validated path can avoid a building laterally or vertically within the ceiling.
